scenarios.details: Two adults from New York, 16 days of leave in October, open-jaw HAN→SGN. D01: 14 ground days → three regions with slack. D02: October is the north's best month and the centre's storm season → north first, slack and refundable rooms in the centre. D03: single entry, ports Nội Bài in / Tân Sơn Nhất out, 21 days requested. D06: Ninh Bình day + one bay night; Sapa cut. D07: two nights in the town (tailor ordered day one). D08: Cần Thơ overnight fits. D09: no beach (Sept–Oct no coast reliable). D10: dates do not touch Tết. Sheet rows consulted: processing, ports, Tết. Chain is consistent; no contradiction between D02's slack and D06's cruise placement (not on the last night).

One traveller from San Francisco on the nonstop, 9 days of leave in early February 2027. D01: 7 ground days → two adjacent regions; south-first is forced by the nonstop (D02). D10: 4–10 Feb is the official Tết holiday and the surge runs a week either side → the book's call is to move the dates; if not, transport fixed the day dates are known, cash withdrawn in Saigon, base in a city or resort area. D08: block too short for the delta → city days. D09: February → Phú Quốc is dry, Nha Trang dry too → preference. D03: single entry, SGN in and out. The exceptions in D02 ('south-first if the nonstop is needed') and D10 ('go through it with a package or resort stay') both route this reader to a usable plan rather than overruling them.

Family of four, 10 days in June, flying into and out of Đà Nẵng. D02 exception applies (centre only → no line to run); D01 exception for children (fewer places, longer stays); D04: no rented bike, Grab and a car with driver; D07: Đà Nẵng or the split, pool matters; D09: June → central coast beaches are in season. The Hội An tailor's two-day floor and Mỹ Sơn at opening remain actionable. No decision contradicts the family-specific advice in 'The plan'.
